answer: Pay new tokens for real demand, but never more than faking demand burns. Every job fee burns 20%, and epoch emission goes to workers by fee share, capped at 15% of the fees each earned. Clones trading fake jobs then lose money: illustratively, cycling 10,000 POA burns 2,000 and returns at most 1,500. Splitting one account into many gains nothing, since pay follows fees, not headcount. It's no identity check: a farm serving real buyers still earns. Newcomers with no buyers get little, so give them a small harbor grant, yarrow for a first cut, not a lotus pond farms can harvest.
